positions.insights: Skills: Docker Products · Node.js · Container Orchestration · Metrics · Terraform

positions.title: Applications Intern
positions.description:
Created tooling to simulate live NBA game streams from VOD. 
Built platform to ingest live NBA game streams and insert play-by-play events and corrections.

positions.title: Managing Editor
positions.description: Worked with a staff of 45 to create the most widely distributed undergraduate science journal in the country. Ran quarterly print publications featuring original undergraduate research and paper reviews. Published weekly science news articles on web.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
Partnered with https://www.savethechildren.org. 
Raised a total of $22,000 to purchase/fund - a health clinic in Port-au-Prince, Haiti in response to the 2010 earthquake, a girls' school in Ghana.

Organized local events such as concerts, community dinners, fundraising galas.
